You are playing Minesweeper on a board of 4 x 4 cells with 2 mines; every set of 2 cells is equally likely. The columns are A to D from the left, the rows 1 to 4 from the top. The orange cell is the cursor. MOVE UP, MOVE DOWN, MOVE LEFT and MOVE RIGHT move the cursor by one cell; FIRE reveals the cell under it. A revealed mine ends the game. A revealed safe cell shows the number of mines among its eight neighbours. The game is won when every safe cell is revealed; it ends when a mine is revealed, after 8 fires on revealed cells, or after 32 actions. You may answer at any time with the mine cells: SUBMIT and the cells, for example SUBMIT B2 D5.
